# @deployed/telegram-gateway

> TypeScript SDK for the Telegram Gateway API — send and verify OTP codes via Telegram.

## Installation

```
npm install @deployed/telegram-gateway
```

## Quick Start

```ts
import { TelegramGateway } from "@deployed/telegram-gateway";

const gateway = new TelegramGateway({ accessToken: "your-token" });

const status = await gateway.sendVerificationMessage({
  phone_number: "+998901234567",
  code_length: 6,
  ttl: 300,
});

const check = await gateway.checkVerificationStatus({
  request_id: status.request_id,
  code: userEnteredCode,
});

if (check.verification_status?.status === "code_valid") {
  // success
}
```

## API

### Constructor

```ts
new TelegramGateway(options: TelegramGatewayOptions)
```

- `accessToken` (string, required): API token from gateway.telegram.org.
- `baseUrl` (string, optional): Override API base URL. Default: `"https://gatewayapi.telegram.org"`.
- `fetch` (Function, optional): Custom fetch implementation.

### sendVerificationMessage(params): Promise<RequestStatus>

Send a verification code via Telegram. Charges per delivery; free to your own number.

Parameters:
- `phone_number` (string, required): E.164 format, e.g. `"+998901234567"`.
- `request_id` (string, optional): ID from `checkSendAbility` — makes this call free.
- `sender_username` (string, optional): Verified Telegram channel username.
- `code` (string, optional): Your own code (4–8 chars). If set, `code_length` is ignored.
- `code_length` (number, optional): Length of Telegram-generated code (4–8).
- `callback_url` (string, optional): HTTPS URL for delivery report callbacks (max 256 bytes).
- `payload` (string, optional): Internal payload, not shown to user (max 128 bytes).
- `ttl` (number, optional): Time-to-live in seconds (30–3600). Default: 120.

Returns: `RequestStatus` with `request_id`, `request_cost`, `remaining_balance`.
Throws: `TelegramGatewayError` on API errors.

### checkSendAbility(params): Promise<SendAbilityResult>

Check if a phone number can receive messages before sending. Never throws on API errors.

Parameters:
- `phone_number` (string, required): E.164 format.

Returns: `{ ok: true, result: RequestStatus }` or `{ ok: false, error: string }`.

If `ok`, pass `result.request_id` to `sendVerificationMessage` to avoid double charge.

### checkVerificationStatus(params): Promise<RequestStatus>

Check delivery status and optionally validate a user-entered code. Always free.

Parameters:
- `request_id` (string, required): From `sendVerificationMessage`.
- `code` (string, optional): User-entered code for server-side validation.

Returns: `RequestStatus` with `delivery_status` and `verification_status`.

`verification_status.status` values: `"code_valid"`, `"code_invalid"`, `"code_max_attempts_exceeded"`, `"expired"`.
`delivery_status.status` values: `"sent"`, `"delivered"`, `"read"`, `"expired"`, `"revoked"`.

### revokeVerificationMessage(params): Promise<true>

Revoke a previously sent message (best-effort). Always free.

Parameters:
- `request_id` (string, required): From `sendVerificationMessage`.

Returns: `true` if accepted.

### verifyCallbackSignature(apiToken, report, maxAgeSeconds?): boolean

Verify integrity of delivery report callbacks from Telegram. Standalone function (not a class method).

```ts
import { verifyCallbackSignature } from "@deployed/telegram-gateway";
```

Parameters:
- `apiToken` (string): Your API token.
- `report` (CallbackReport): `{ timestamp, signature, body }` from request headers and raw body.
- `maxAgeSeconds` (number, optional): Max timestamp age. Default: 300 (5 min).

Returns: `true` if signature is valid and timestamp is fresh.

Important: Pass the raw body string, not parsed/re-serialized JSON.

## Error Handling

All methods (except `checkSendAbility`) throw `TelegramGatewayError` on failure.

```ts
import { TelegramGatewayError } from "@deployed/telegram-gateway";

try {
  await gateway.sendVerificationMessage({ phone_number: "+1234567890" });
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof TelegramGatewayError) {
    console.error(err.code); // e.g. "PHONE_NUMBER_INVALID"
  }
}
```

## Key Types

```ts
import type {
  RequestStatus,
  DeliveryStatus,
  VerificationStatus,
  SendVerificationMessageParams,
  CheckSendAbilityParams,
  CheckVerificationStatusParams,
  RevokeVerificationMessageParams,
  SendAbilityResult,
  CallbackReport,
} from "@deployed/telegram-gateway";
```
